dict.string: ntakker-cli records the microphone alongside system audio. Audio is written only to the file path you pass via --output. Nothing is sent over the network.
ntakker-cli uses the Screen Recording permission to capture system audio (the audio output of all running applications) via ScreenCaptureKit. No video frames are saved; only audio is recorded.

ntakker-cli uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe captured audio into a transcript sidecar. Audio never leaves your Mac.
